key_concepts: Scientific definition of work in physics
Work requires a net force and displacement in the direction of the force
No work is done when there is no displacement
No work is done when force is perpendicular to displacement
Work is maximum when force and displacement are parallel
Work can be calculated using force, displacement, and the angle between them
Work is measured in joules or newton-meters
Power is the rate of doing work
Power is calculated as work divided by time
Power is measured in watts or joules per second
Horsepower is another unit of power
Kilowatt-hour is a unit of energy, not power
